name: What areas do you serve for fixture installation coordination?

mainEntity.name: What areas do you serve for fixture installation coordination?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction provides fixture installation coordination services in a broad area within the East Bay and surrounding regions. Our primary service areas include Berkeley, Oakland, Albany, and El Cerrito. We also extend our services to other nearby communities such as Kensington, Alameda, San Francisco, Sausalito, Tiburon, Mill Valley, Daly City, Brisbane, and South San Francisco, covering much of the East Bay and parts of the wider San Francisco Bay Area. If your project is located within these areas, we are equipped to assist with your fixture installation needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Frasheski Construction serves Berkeley, Oakland, Albany, El Cerrito, and surrounding East Bay communities for fixture installation coordination.
